card.name: Dose unit right before frequency
card.fires_on: The last word of a dose amount (tsp, drop, mg, a closing parenthesis after mL, or a route like IV) just before the dosing interval, such as b.i.d., q6h, every 4 to 6 hours or four times a day.

modes.label: Measure before interval
modes.description: A unit such as tsp, drop, mg or /kg ends the dose and the schedule comes next.
modes.example: 8 kg 1/2 tsp b.i.d. 40 mg/kg/day (Otitis Media) 9 kg 1/2<< tsp>> b.i.d. 18 kg

modes.label: Bracket or route before interval
modes.description: A closing parenthesis after a volume, or a route word like IV or intramuscularly, comes just before every N hours.
modes.example: Adults 1 teaspoonful (5 mL<<)>> every 4 to 6 hours,

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing frequency words like daily, weekly and q next.
card.plain: It marks the spot right after a dose amount where the dosing schedule is about to be written.
